description: Introduces a machine-learning-based checkout optimization layer that dynamically pre-fills user payment and shipping details, performs real-time fraud risk scoring, and reorders checkout form fields based on predicted user intent. The AI scoring pipeline runs inline with each checkout session, leveraging a lightweight transformer model hosted on edge infrastructure.
known_issues: Payment gateway (Stripe) experiences intermittent timeouts under concurrent AI scoring load above ~18k DAU threshold
Edge-case transaction flow failure when AI risk score falls in 0.47–0.53 probability band — triggers indefinite loading state instead of fallback
AI model inference latency increases non-linearly beyond 15k concurrent sessions due to shared GPU memory contention on edge nodes
Android WebView versions below 114 fail to render AI-driven dynamic form reordering, causing blank checkout fields
Double-charge race condition present when user retries a payment that silently failed but was actually queued
expected_impact: Reduce average checkout completion time by 35%
Improve returning user payment success rate through pre-filled credentials
Lower manual form abandonment via intent-based field reordering
Reduce fraudulent transactions by 18% through inline risk scoring
rollback_plan: Feature flag `ff_smart_checkout_enabled` can be toggled per-user cohort via LaunchDarkly. Full rollback estimated at 12 minutes. Data pipeline replay required for any sessions mid-transaction during rollback window.
monitoring_alerts: PagerDuty alert: api_latency_p95 > 400ms for 5+ consecutive minutes
PagerDuty alert: payment_failure_rate > 5% over rolling 30-minute window
Datadog anomaly monitor: crash_rate deviation > 2 standard deviations from 7-day baseline
Slack alert: support_ticket_volume > 500 in a single day
